decision_rule: Return bounded_empirical_support only when all positive controls, dedicated and pooled completeness, free consistency, worst-seed no-drift, pooled no-drift, local-frame, tire-truth, exact-replay, and no-free-slide-counterexample gates pass in every full cell.
